Subject: Coverage Synapse — Close Velocity & Stage Lock Checklist (EMEA/APAC)

Team,

Quick heads-up as we move into the final two weeks of the quarter. Attached is a lightweight checklist (stage-lock-checklist-EMEA-APAC.pdf) and a tracker for open high-velocity deals (commit-tracker-9421.xlsx). Goal is to get stage updates and firm commit signals for EMEA/APAC accounts that we expect to convert in Oct/Nov.

Please do the following by EOD Monday:
- Update Stage + Best Case / Commit column in the tracker for any account you own in EMEA/APAC.
- Flag any accounts with outstanding procurement or SOC 2 evidence asks in the tracker notes.
- If you need a short canary/backup model (lower-cost variant) approved for a customer pilot, put it in column "fallback_model_req" so I can route to Product for sign-off.

I'll compile a rollup Tuesday morning and call out anything that needs a finance/discount escalation. If you anticipate a change to the ARR or split across months, add a comment in the file (don't overwrite historical notes).

Thanks — Kim

--
Kimberly Park
Director, EMEA Sales Operations

Heads-up — finance pinged me on Zenova (DEAL-9421): they want visibility on monthly recognition if we allow a pilot discount and how that would impact our quarter cadence. Two asks from Finance:
1) If we give a pilot discount that affects billable ARR, we need a clear start/end date and a path to net-positive within 90 days. Can the AE commit to a three-month pilot with step-up pricing?
2) If procurement insists on a 60-day payment term, Finance wants a signed DocuSign with payment terms explicitly called out so AR can forecast collections.

Vanessa: can you capture the pilot term you expect in the tracker and loop Thomas at Zenova (tmuller@zenova.com) on the payment-term ask? If procurement@zenova.com needs a template, I can drop the standard 60-day addendum.

Aditya

Date: 2027-10-09T17:06:00Z
Subject: Re: Coverage Synapse — Close Velocity & Stage Lock Checklist (EMEA/APAC)

Team + Thomas/Zenova — thanks for the updates. Consolidated next steps: 
1) Vanessa — please confirm pilot term in the tracker. If Zenova agrees to a 90-day pilot with step-up pricing, Finance will treat it as a timebound discount and not adjust ARR recognition beyond the pilot.
2) Thomas / procurement@zenova.com — if you prefer 60-day terms, please confirm in reply and we will include the 60-day addendum in the DocuSign. Aditya has the template ready.
3) All internal owners — I will lock stages in the tracker at 08:00 UTC on Monday (2027-10-11). If you have any last-minute changes, flag the row with "LOCK-EXCEPTION" and add a short note — avoid passive comments.

I ran a quick risk filter: any deal with "legal_pending" + "procurement_pending" will be escalated to the revenue ops call on Wednesday. If you're on the call, be ready with ETA and blocking next steps.

I'll send the rollup to Finance Tuesday morning with a single line per deal: account, owner, commit amount, expected close date, outstanding blockers.

Attachments: commit-tracker-9421.xlsx, stage-lock-checklist-EMEA-APAC.pdf

Kim
